description: Create a narrower key: push only, or bound to one dashboard. Shown once. A Push key bound to one dashboard is the right key for a CI job or a cron that only sends data. Solo owners hold at most five live keys. Needs an API key: with none yet, call signup first.

dashboardId.description: Bind the key to one of the owner's dashboards: it then reaches only that dashboard's visuals.

scope.description: push: send data and read visuals. manage: everything this key can do.

name: create_api_key
title: Create api key
